# sailpoint_source_attribute_sync_config (Data Source)

Data source for SailPoint Source Attribute Sync Config. Returns the full attribute sync configuration for a source, including all syncable attributes and their current enabled state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sailpoint_source_attribute_sync_config" "ad" {
  source_id = sailpoint_source.ad.id
}

output "synced_attributes" {
  value = [
    for attr in data.sailpoint_source_attribute_sync_config.ad.attributes :
    attr.name if attr.enabled
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_id` (String) The ID of the source to look up.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Attributes Set) All syncable attributes for the source and their current enabled state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes))
- `id` (String) Resource identifier — mirrors `source_id`.
- `source` (Attributes) Reference to the source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))

<a id="nestedatt--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) The human-readable display name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this attribute is currently synced to the source.
- `name` (String) The identity attribute name.
- `target` (String) The account attribute name on the target source.


<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
